why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: Check @tydroHQ for news that markets have reopened. The account x.com/tydro belongs to an unrelated musician.

Use only the official site. Tydro's docs say tydro.com "is the only official URL of the tydro app and documentation". They add: "The team will never ask you to use another interface or ask for sensitive information such as private keys or personal information."

Once markets reopen, bridge assets to Ink. "Using Tydro takes a wallet connected to the Ink network with some assets in it." Tydro names "Bungee, Super Bridge, the USDT0 Native Bridge, and the Aave Bridge." You'll need a little ETH on Ink for gas.
Connect your wallet at app.tydro.com and supply an eligible asset. The current campaigns cover USDC, USDT0, WETH, USDG and kHYPE. Points then build up on their own.

Optional: borrow, which also earns points but adds risk. Warning Tydro's docs say: "If collateral falls in value, the gauge drops, and collateral can be lost to liquidation." Liquidations still run during the freeze, so check any open loan now.
Claim TydroInkPoints when you want. The app says: "Rewards are claimable on Merkl". This is the points token, not INK.
Watch inkfnd.com and @inkfndhq for INK news. Kraken says INK "will be airdropped to eligible, active Kraken clients and ecosystem participants."
